다음 문장에서 틀린 부분은 어디일까요?

items.title: A Surprise for Dad
items.text: Next Saturday is my father's birthday. My sister and I are going to make a cake for him. Mom will buy the eggs and milk at the market this afternoon. We are going to hide the cake in the kitchen until evening. After dinner, we will sing a song together. I think Dad will be very happy.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A shopping trip to a big market
A family's plan for a birthday
A song contest at our school
A cooking lesson about baking bread
qs.why: 글 전체가 아버지 생신을 위한 가족의 계획을 이야기해요.

qs.q: Who will buy the eggs and milk?
qs.why: 세 번째 문장에서 Mom will buy the eggs and milk라고 했어요.

qs.q: Where will the cake stay until evening?
qs.why: We are going to hide the cake in the kitchen until evening.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: When will the family sing a song?
qs.why: After dinner, we will sing a song together.라고 했어요.

qs.q: How does the writer feel about the plan?
o: Worried that the cake will burn
Sad that Dad is too busy to come
Angry that Mom is late again
Hopeful that Dad will enjoy it
qs.why: 글쓴이는 아빠가 매우 기뻐할 거라고 생각해요(I think Dad will be very happy).

items.title: Tomorrow's Weather
items.text: Here is tomorrow's weather. In the morning, it will be cloudy, but it will not rain. In the afternoon, the sun will come out and the temperature will go up to twenty-five degrees. In the evening, strong winds are going to blow from the sea. Take a jacket if you plan to walk outside tonight.

qs.q: Why was this text written?
o: To teach children how to swim safely
To sell warm jackets at a clothing shop
To tell people about the weather
To describe a trip from last week
qs.why: 내일 날씨를 알려 주는 글이에요.

qs.q: What will the morning be like?
o: Rainy, cold, and a little dark
Windy, cloudy, and a bit rainy
Cloudy, but with no rain at all
qs.why: In the morning, it will be cloudy, but it will not rain.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What will happen to the temperature in the afternoon?
qs.why: the temperature will go up이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What are the evening winds going to do?
qs.why: strong winds are going to blow from the sea라고 했어요.

items.title: Mina's Summer Camp
items.text: Mina is going to go to a summer camp in July. She will stay there for five days. At the camp, she is going to swim in a lake, climb a small mountain, and make new friends. She will not bring her phone because the camp has a no-phone rule. Instead, she is going to write a diary every night. After the camp, she will show it to her mother.

qs.q: How long will Mina stay at the camp?
qs.why: She will stay there for five days.라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why won't Mina bring her phone?
o: It is too heavy to carry there.
The camp does not allow phones.
Her mother lost it last week.
It could easily break in the lake.
qs.why: the camp has a no-phone rule이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is Mina going to do every night?
qs.why: she is going to write a diary every night라고 했어요.

qs.q: In the last sentence, ‘it’ means ___.
qs.why: 앞 문장에서 쓴 일기(diary)를 어머니께 보여 준다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Which of these will Mina do at the camp?
qs.why: At the camp, she is going to ... make new friends라고 했어요.

items.title: Robot Helpers
items.text: In the future, robots will help us at home. A robot will wash the dishes, water the plants, and carry heavy bags. Some people think robots will take care of old people too. But a robot will not understand our feelings like a friend does. So I believe humans and robots are going to work together. What do you think?

qs.q: What does the writer believe?
o: Robots will replace all of our friends.
People and robots will work together.
Robots will never be allowed in homes.
Homes will not need any help at all.
qs.why: So I believe humans and robots are going to work together.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What will a robot not understand?
qs.why: a robot will not understand our feelings like a friend does라고 했어요.

qs.q: In this text, ‘carry’ means ___.
o: throw something away into the trash
wash something with soap and water
hold something and take it somewhere
qs.why: carry heavy bags는 무거운 가방을 들고 옮긴다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does the writer end with ‘What do you think?’
o: To ask readers for their ideas
To say that the writer is lost
To finish a story about a friend
qs.why: 독자도 자기 생각을 해 보도록 묻는 마무리예요.

How many books does you have?
How many book do you have?
items.rule: How many 뒤에는 복수명사가 오고, 이어서 do + 주어 + 동사원형 순서로 써요.

items.good: Do they eat lunch at school?
bad: Does they eat lunch at school?
Do they eats lunch at school?
Are they eat lunch at school?
items.rule: 주어가 they이면 일반동사 의문문은 Do + 주어 + 동사원형 ~?이에요.

items.good: She didn't go to the party because she was sick.
bad: She didn't went to the party because she was sick.
She not go to the party because she was sick.
She didn't goes to the party because she was sick.

cz.st: She didn't ___ to the party because she was sick.

items.rule: didn't 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. because 뒤의 절은 따로 과거 형태를 써요.

items.q: ‘I like fish.’를 부정문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 일반동사 문장은 don't(doesn't, didn't)를 이용해 부정문을 만들어요. 주어가 I이므로 don't를 써요.

items.q: ‘She plays tennis.’를 의문문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 주어가 3인칭 단수이므로 Does를 쓰고, 동사는 원형 play로 바꿔요.

items.q: ‘He is a doctor.’를 부정문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: be동사의 부정문은 be동사 뒤에 not을 붙여요.

items.q: ‘We eat pizza.’를 과거 부정문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 과거 부정문은 didn't + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: ‘They can swim.’을 의문문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: can이 있는 문장은 can을 주어 앞으로 보내서 의문문을 만들어요.

items.q: ‘There are two cats in the garden.’을 의문문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
o: Is there two cats in the garden?
Do there are two cats in the garden?
Are there two cats in the garden?
Are two cats there in the garden?
items.why: There are ~는 are를 there 앞으로 보내 Are there ~?로 물어요.

items.q: ‘She lives in Busan.’에서 장소를 묻는 의문문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: Where + does + 주어 + 동사원형 ~? 순서로 써요.

items.q: ‘I am happy.’의 부정문을 줄임말로 바르게 쓴 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: am not은 amn't로 줄이지 않고 I'm not으로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 의문문인 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: Do로 시작하고 물음표로 끝나는 문장이 의문문이에요.

items.q: A: Does Jane have a pet? B: No, ___.
items.why: Does로 묻는 질문에는 does를 이용해 대답해요. No, she doesn't.가 알맞아요.

items.q: ‘This is a book.’의 부정문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: be동사 문장은 be동사 뒤에 not을 붙여요.

items.q: ‘You cleaned your room.’을 의문문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 과거 의문문은 Did + 주어 + 동사원형이에요.

items.q:
다음 문장에서 틀린 부분은 무엇일까요?
Does he likes pizza?
items.why: Does 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 해요. likes를 like로 고쳐요.

items.q: ___ she go to school by bus?
items.why: 주어가 she인 일반동사 의문문이므로 Does를 쓰고 go는 원형으로 둬요.

items.q: ‘I have a brother.’의 부정문은 무엇일까요?
o: I am not have a brother.
items.why: 일반동사 have의 부정문은 don't have예요.

items.q: ‘Open the door.’를 ‘문을 열지 마세요’라는 뜻으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 명령문의 부정은 동사원형 앞에 Don't를 붙여요.

items.q: ‘He was sleepy.’를 의문문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: be동사 과거 의문문은 Was를 주어 앞으로 보내요.

items.q: 다음 중 어순이 바른 의문문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 의문사 + does + 주어 + 동사원형 순서로 써요. 의문사가 맨 앞에 와요.

items.q: ‘She likes dogs.’에서 dogs를 묻는 질문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 무엇을 좋아하는지 묻는 What does she like?가 알맞아요.

items.q: ‘There are five apples.’에서 수를 묻는 질문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: How many 뒤에는 복수명사가 오고, are there가 이어져요.

items.q: ‘Tom broke the window.’에서 Tom을 묻는 질문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 주어를 묻는 Who 질문은 do/did 없이 Who + 동사 ~?로 써요.

items.q: ‘I am tired.’를 과거 부정문으로 바꾼 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: am의 과거형은 was이므로 I wasn't tired.가 돼요.

items.q: A: Do you walk to school? B: ___
items.why: Do로 묻는 질문에는 Yes, I do.로 대답해요.

items.q: ‘I can run fast.’의 부정문은 무엇일까요?
items.why: can의 부정문은 can't + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: ‘너는 어제 뭐 했니?’를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: 과거 질문은 What did you do ~?이고, did 뒤의 do는 원형이에요.

items.q: ‘isn't’를 풀어 쓴 것은 무엇일까요?
items.why: isn't는 is not의 줄임말이에요.

items.title: A New Classmate
items.text: Today a new student came to our class. His name is Jun. He isn't shy, and he likes to talk. At lunch, I asked him, "Do you like soccer?" He said, "Yes, I do. Do you play too?" I answered, "I don't play, but I watch every game." Then we both laughed. I think we will be good friends.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: Playing in a soccer game after lunch
Talking with a new classmate at lunch
Cooking a special lunch for the class
Moving to a different school this year
qs.why: 새로 온 친구 준과 처음 대화하는 이야기예요.

qs.q: In the passage, ‘shy’ means ___.
o: afraid to talk to new people
tired after a long school day
qs.why: shy는 낯선 사람과 이야기하기를 부끄러워하는 것을 뜻해요. 준은 말하기를 좋아한다고 했어요.

qs.q: What does the writer do about soccer?
o: Plays it with Jun every day
Teaches it to the new student
Watches it but does not play
qs.why: I don't play, but I watch every game.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: In ‘Yes, I do,’ the word ‘do’ stands for ___.
qs.why: 앞의 질문 Do you like soccer?에서 like soccer를 대신해요.

qs.q: How does the writer feel at the end?
o: Sorry about a mistake at lunch
Bored with the long lesson today
qs.why: 글쓴이는 둘이 좋은 친구가 될 것 같다고 생각해요.

items.title: Library Rules
items.text: Welcome to our school library! Please follow these rules. Don't eat or drink inside. Don't talk loudly. You can borrow three books for two weeks. Do you want to keep a book longer? Ask the librarian. Don't forget to return your books on time. Thank you!

qs.q: Why was this notice written?
o: To invite students to a reading club
To advertise a book sale at school
To explain how to use the library
To announce a new teacher's name
qs.why: 도서관에서 지켜야 할 규칙을 알려 주는 안내문이에요.

qs.q: How many books can a student borrow?
qs.why: You can borrow three books for two weeks.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What should you do to keep a book longer?
o: Put it back on the shelf
qs.why: Do you want to keep a book longer? Ask the librarian.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: In this notice, ‘borrow’ means ___.
o: give something to a friend for free
buy something new at a shop today
lose something by mistake on the way
use something and then return it
qs.why: borrow는 잠시 빌려서 쓰고 돌려주는 것을 뜻해요.

qs.q: Which thing is NOT allowed in the library?
qs.why: Don't eat or drink inside.라고 했어요.

items.title: Grandpa's Childhood
items.text: I interviewed my grandfather for a school project. "Did you have a computer when you were young?" I asked. "No, we didn't," he said. "We didn't have phones or TVs either. We played outside all day." "Was it boring?" "Not at all! We were always busy." I was surprised. Life was very different then.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A school project about playing computer games
How the grandfather's childhood was different
A sports day at the grandfather's old school
A trip to see the grandfather's old friends
qs.why: 할아버지의 어린 시절이 오늘날과 어떻게 달랐는지를 이야기하는 글이에요.

qs.q: Why did the writer talk to the grandfather?
o: For a gift on his birthday
qs.why: I interviewed my grandfather for a school project.라고 했어요.

qs.q: What did the grandfather NOT have when he was young?
o: Fun things to do all day
qs.why: 컴퓨터가 있었냐는 질문에 No, we didn't라고 답했어요. 반면 하루 종일 바깥에서 놀았다고 했어요.

qs.q: What does the grandfather think about his childhood?
o: It was too quiet for him.
It was not boring at all.
It was very lonely at times.
qs.why: Not at all! We were always busy.라고 대답했어요.

qs.q: In this passage, ‘busy’ means ___.
qs.why: busy는 할 일이 많아 바쁘다는 뜻이에요.

items.title: Where Is My Umbrella?
items.text: Hi Eun, are you at home? I can't find my umbrella. Did I leave it at your house yesterday? It isn't in my bag, and it isn't in my room. It is blue with white dots. Please check the hall. I don't need it today, but I will need it tomorrow because it is going to rain. Thanks! From Sora

qs.q: Why did Sora write this message?
o: To invite Eun to a party this weekend
To ask Eun to check for her umbrella
To thank Eun for a gift she gave
To tell Eun about a trip to the sea
qs.why: 소라는 우산을 어제 은의 집에 두고 온 것 같아 찾아봐 달라고 부탁해요.

qs.q: Where has Sora already looked?
o: In the hall at Eun's house
At the school gate near home
In her bag and in her room
In the kitchen of her house
qs.why: It isn't in my bag, and it isn't in my room.이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does the umbrella look like?
qs.why: It is blue with white dots.라고 했어요.

qs.q: Why will Sora need the umbrella tomorrow?
o: She is going on a long trip.
Her mother wants to borrow it.
It is going to rain tomorrow.
qs.why: it is going to rain 때문에 내일 필요하다고 했어요.

qs.q: In this message, ‘check’ means ___.
o: write it down in a notebook
look to see if it is there
wash it with soap and water
give it to a friend as a gift
qs.why: check the hall은 현관을 살펴보라는 뜻이에요.

items.ex: Please change the sentence to a question.
